messages:
Alex Kim: FYI finance pushed new premium pricing tiers today — higher per-minute token quota + higher QPS. Can eng-infra model expected GPU-hour delta for next quarter? Asking for rough/fast numbers by EOD.

Maria Gonzalez: Quick q — do we have an estimate of migration % from standard -> premium? Product hinted 6-8% conversion from current cohort.

Chris Patel: If we assume 7% migration and premium traffic is 2.5x latency-sensitive QPS, rough calc: current monthly GPU-hours = 180k. Premium adds ~0.07 * 2.5 * 180k = 31.5k GPU-hours/mo. + overhead (cache misses, cold starts) ~ +20% => ~37.8k GPU-hrs/mo. ballpark.

Samir Rao: I'm skeptical of the 2.5x factor for all regions. EU has tight A100 availability; if traffic shifts there we need reserved capacity. Suggest: reserve +15k GPU-hrs for EU dedicated pool and autoscale pool for rest. Also recommend a 25% safety buffer for first 6 weeks.

Priya Shah: Important: premium tiers also increase per-minute token quota from 1M -> 2.5M and bump burst limit from 500 -> 2k QPS. That material changes KV cache hit patterns — expect more cache cold miss ratio for short-lived sessions, which increases tokens processed per request. See quick note: "cold_miss_penalty ~= 1.12x tokens/req".

Alex Kim: Good call. Can someone drop a quick calc snippet we can paste into the finance deck? Need assumptions + sensitivity (best/mid/worst).

Chris Patel: Paste below
```
assume_current_gpu_hours = 180000
migration_pct = 0.07
premium_qps_multiplier = 2.5
cold_miss_factor = 1.12
base = assume_current_gpu_hours * migration_pct * premium_qps_multiplier
with_overhead = base * cold_miss_factor * 1.20  # +20% infra overhead
=> round(with_overhead) = 37800  # GPU-hours / month
```

Maria Gonzalez: I'll link to a live sheet and run best/mid/worst (5%/7%/10%). https://redwood.co/sheets/premium-capacity-forecast :eyes:

Samir Rao: Ops notes: If we provision reserved for EU, we should do short-term reservations (3mo) not 12mo. Also consider using quantized variants for burst handling to avoid capacity spike on A100.

Deploy Bot: reminder: capacity-reservation form submitted? Use https://redwood.co/internal/reservations. Auto-approvals available for requests <10k GPU-hours.

Priya Shah: TL;DR: Mid-case ~38k GPU-hrs/mo extra. Worst-case (10% migration + 3x qps + higher cold misses) ~70k GPU-hrs/mo. Need finance to pre-approve spend runway and for product to stagger rollout by region. :thumbsup:

Alex Kim: Thanks — can someone post the final tidy numbers + spreadsheet tab by EOD? I'll escalate to Finance if EU reserved looks unavoidable. :pray:

Maria Gonzalez: will do. cc @Chris Patel @Samir Rao
